assessment: E. coli EmrE and other members of the SMR family of transporters utilize the proton motive force to pump out a broad spectrum of antibiotics, thereby contributing to multi-drug resistance. Here, a new multipurpose crystallization chaperone is used to determine the structure of EmrE in apo form and in complex with various substrates. The strength of the manuscript is in the description of six new structures of EmrE at a resolution sufficient for building an atomic model and understanding how the antimicrobial agents bind, allowing robust conclusions to be drawn regarding the molecular details of binding of the antimicrobial agents. The report will be of interest to both those studying antibiotic resistance and those studying transporters.
